body:
Worker runs on the codex harness (seen with the deepseek model on task:76554b1e77976ad7) open with three entries shown as errors:

1. Two copies of "`[features].multi_agent` is deprecated…". Solace's own codex settings file switches that feature off, and the installed codex now warns about it.
2. "Model metadata for `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` not found. Defaulting to fallback metadata." Solace already ignores this warning when it decides why a run failed, but the run still lists it as an error.

Done when a new codex run no longer opens with these errors. Real errors must still show.

Open point: the full text of the first warning is cut off in the run log, so read it from the run's steps to see which setting codex wants instead.
title: codex: no startup errors in runs
